Hi, I think I've been charged twice for my September plan. Could you take a look?
A
Alex Morgan
09:00
Hi Maya, you're through to Alex. I'm sorry to hear about the duplicate charge. I'll help you check it.
A
Alex Morgan
09:00
Before we discuss your account, could you confirm the last four digits of the phone number on it?
M
Maya Patel
09:00
Sure, 4821.
A
Alex Morgan
09:01
Thank you, that's verified. I can see two payments of £29 on 27 September. One was a duplicate and has not yet been refunded.
M
Maya Patel
09:01
That's a relief. I was worried I'd have to dispute it with my bank.
A
Alex Morgan
09:01
I understand the concern. I've submitted a refund for the extra £29 payment. It should return to the same card within five working days.
M
Maya Patel
09:01
Great, will I receive a confirmation?
A
Alex Morgan
09:02
Yes. A confirmation email will be sent today. If the refund hasn't appeared after five working days, reply to that email and quote reference REF-2048. Is there anything else I can help with?
M
Maya Patel
09:02
No, that's everything. Thanks for sorting it out.
A
Alex Morgan
09:02
You're welcome, Maya. Thanks for getting in touch, and have a good day.
